newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Chinese general visits Zaire, to meet Mobutu.
newsitem.headline: Chinese general visits Zaire, to meet Mobutu.

text.p: A senior Chinese army general has arrived in Zaire for talks with President Mobutu Sese Seko at his jungle palace, Zaire's state radio said on Wednesday.

It said the visit by General Fu Quanyou, chief of the general staff of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, was the first to Zaire by a high-ranking Chinese officer and "shows that military cooperation between the two countries is going well."
Fu arrived from neighbouring Congo on Tuesday.
It was not clear if his visit had been scheduled before rebels seized a large tract of eastern Zaire last October, threatening to break up the vast Central African nation.
Mobutu was in Europe for cancer treatment when the rebellion erupted. He cut short his stay and returned home last month vowing that Zaire's retreating army would take back all seized territory.
Zaire and China have had warm relations for decades with Chinese cultural assistance the most obvious manifestation of their ties. The level of military cooperation is not clear.
The radio said Fu met his Zairean counterpart before leaving for Mobutu's palace in remote Gbadolite.
